Note key: H14. Crates: none (repo ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec). Size: S.

Spec: object-history-03 §7.2 adds a 'Supports History' column (Yes/No) to the JMAP Data Types registry; the default is No for registrations without a value. Design: docs/design/object-history.md §9 'Spec repository'.

Work in ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec. Follow that repo's AGENTS.md: read each file in full first, grep the guides for affected text, and do not commit without Mark's approval.

Add a 'Supports History' field to every registration entry, in each draft's existing entry format:
- draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md (definition-list format, about l.1892): ChatContact, Chat, Message, Space, SpaceInvite, CustomEmoji, SpaceBan = Yes; ReadPosition, PresenceStatus = No.
- draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00.md (about l.636): KeyPackage = No (decision 22).
- draft-atwood-jmap-graph-00.md (one-line format, about l.506): Graph, GraphNode, GraphEdge = Yes.
- draft-atwood-jmap-graph-edit-00.md: GraphNodeOp = No.
- draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md (about l.2985): SceneRegion, SceneObject, SceneAsset = Yes; SceneAvatar = No.
- draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md (about l.1974): VTCCall, VTCRecording, VTCLivestream = Yes; VTCParticipant = No.
All values are confirmed by decision 22.

Citations:
- Each edited draft cites the column's source as {{JMAP-OBJ-HISTORY}}. Add the informative reference entry where it is missing; copy the one in chat-00.
- Update the existing JMAP-OBJ-HISTORY references in chat-00 and graph-provenance-00 from -02 to the posted draft-ietf-jmap-object-history-03 (2026-11-02).
- Check that chat-00's Message note (about l.782, 'MAY list "Message" in supportedTypes') still reads consistently. Decision 22 relies on it (no prior or destroyed Message versions after deletion; versions removed on delete or hard delete) and on chat-00 §Space/set about l.1395 ("Hard-deletes all records; no tombstones are retained"), which it reads as purging the history of the Space and everything in it; check both still say that, and report rather than edit if they do not.

- All six drafts render without errors.
- Every registration entry has exactly one Supports History value, matching decision 22.
